book_vs_repo_gap: This appendix captures the compositional core of CCG, but not type raising, composition variants, or wide-coverage parsing.

chapter_notes.counterintuitive_insight: The power of CCG is not fancy trees but the discipline of directional types that force composition to reveal semantic structure.
covered_claims: Lexical categories and application-based derivations are explicit.
Simple and transitive-verb examples both reduce to sentence categories.
omitted_claims: No type raising or full wide-coverage lexicon.

failure_modes.note: Swapping slash direction changes whether composition is legal.
The appendix captures application but not the richer combinatory inventory of full CCG analyses.

lesson_objectives: Represent lexical items as directional categories.
Show forward and backward application in a CCG derivation.
Connect composition steps to semantic assembly.
title: Combinatory Categorial Grammar
